A quick write up of how moderation differs on Voat compared to eddit...

Every subverse on Voat has public moderation logs showing removed submissions, removed comments and banned users. It's not possible for a moderator to disable these logs so everything removed by a moderator on Voat is viewable. Links to these can be found at the bottom of a subverses sidebar, or you can manually view them by using the following URL format...

  • voat.co/v/<subverse>/modlog/deleted
  • voat.co/v/<subverse>/modlog/deletedcomments
  • voat.co/v/<subverse>/modlog/bannedusers

If your account is banned or your content removed then you will automatically receive a private message, there's no way for moderators on Voat to silently ban or remove your content.

The role of a moderator on Voat is simple, remove spam, harmful links such as malware and scams but not peoples opinions - https://voat.co/help/faq and https://voat.co/help/useragreement

If you want to self promote then you should purchase ad space - https://voat.co/advertize

There's been a small number of subverse moderators that have crossed the line in the past, these have been dealt with by the community (https://voat.co/v/ProtectVoat)) and in some cases by the Voat admins removing problematic moderators (https://voat.co/v/announcements/404524, https://voat.co/v/announcements/729257 and https://voat.co/v/announcements/1554065)).

If you want to setup your own subverse with strict moderation then you must clearly define the rules on the sidebar from the beginning. If you moderate a subverse with a generic name then all content that isn't spam should be allowed for that subject (https://voat.co/v/announcements/1557385))...

Moderators that control generic subverses must allow free conversation to occur and not stifle it, unless clearly defined upon subverse creation.

This rule is intended to cover a situation such that a subverse moderator decides to ban all Toyota posts from a subverse called v/vehicles.

People are always free to submit whatever content they want to /v/whatever which is basically unmoderated.

If you see any illegal content or doxing then email the Voat admins - https://voat.co/about
